errors.evidence: The figure contains three pie charts, each with four sectors, not eight sectors as stated.

errors.evidence: The figure uses four sectors: Industry (yellow), Construction (blue), Trade (red), and Other Services (brown). The described sectors and colors do not match the figure.

errors.text_span: Процентите на всеки сектор са посочени вътре в съответните сегменти: 1,6%, 24,8%, 5,4%, 17,3%, 5,7%, 4,8%, 6,8% и 33,6%.
errors.evidence: The percentages listed do not correspond to the values in the figure, which are 61%, 8%, 19%, 12% for enterprises; 51%, 9%, 19%, 21% for employment; and 31%, 6%, 31%, 33% for turnover.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the chart represents enterprises, employment, and turnover by industry, construction, trade, and services in 2021.
The description does not mention the labels of the three pie charts: 'NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES,' 'NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED,' and 'TURNOVER.'
The description does not mention the absolute values displayed in each segment of the pie charts (e.g., 19.0 mln, 80.2 mln, 9.8 trn).
The description does not mention the legend indicating the four sectors: Industry (yellow), Construction (blue), Trade (red), and Other Services (brown).
The description does not mention that the sectors are not visually ordered by size in the pie charts.
